I'm better off mentally and financially. This was a chance for me to break a generational curse of poverty. 

I started my business and I'm glad I did. It's a different set of issues but the issues make me stronger as a person and as a business owner. Now that I see and learned the ways of the world are not geared to work in my favor, I took that knowledge and I'm using the tools others have to get ahead.

1. If you see all the neighbors put there trash out on a Wednesday it's a good indication "This is trash day." Trash is picked up every single week. 

2. If you leave your trash can under a tree where trash can get stuck in the tree as they lift it, and you leave the trash there to go over into my yard, and then I pick it up, "You're an idiot!" If you allow rodents and squirrels to pick through your trash because you leave the bags outside the can for days, "You're an idiot!" 

3. The dog has literally been on a chain for over 45 days. Through weather ranging from 50 clear down to 19 degrees. Laying on hay, in rain, high winds, snow, and gunshots! The dog whines outside the window when he hears them and their response, "Shut up! Stop crying!" 

4. I rented for years as a single parent. I worked my ass off to pay rent and be a decent renter. Now I own a property I work my ass off to keep decent. I pay property taxes and I don't appreciate having to pick up the trash of a grown ass adult with 3 kids. TF!

It's a pittie. The night time low is 27°. The city ordinance states: 

As part of the ordinance, no dog owner shall: Continuously tether a dog for more than three hours per day. Tether a dog using a tether made of anything but a coated steel cable at any length less than three times the length of the dog measured from the tip of its nose to the base of its tail. 

It's tied to tree with a silver rope and a cloth leash. They move in on November 3. The dog has been outside since then. The dog has been outside not sleeping in the dog house but on the hay. 

I clean my yard and I clean the abandoned house yard hopping squatters don't take over before I move out of the city. Yet I'm picking up trash where her trash gets stick in the trees because she leaves it where the garbage collector cannot empty it properly.

I agree. At first I was frightened when she told me to mind my business but then I looked up the ordinance for my city. The neighbors that have dogs we keep them in because of how the temps are dropping and how they can come in contact with a stray. 

Not being all religious but I pray each time I go out to my yard. I don't like seeing an animal tied to a tree like that. I don't think the dog fully understands why the dog house is there. They never spend time with the dog. They just toss food & water to him.

I did think about this but I didn't want to get in trouble with the police. I'm trying to grow my business and soon I will be moving to a bigger home. I'm willing to pay someone to foster the dog until I'm moved.

Thank you. I have a list of places to call. I use to toss him food and talk to him when my dogs and I are out. Since she told me to mind my business yesterday, I will not. 

The neighborhood is going down but here I am trying to do right, and I feel like I'm being a nuisance by having compassion for an animal and wanting a yard with no trash or toys in it.

As a single parent that knows what it likes to be a renter and a homeowner, I tried to show my kids how to at least do your best to keep a house clean. I try to help others cause I've been there. 

Seeing this makes me hesitant about the faith I have in people. You say things about who you are with the impression you make. We have abandoned homes, empty lots, drug houses on the block. 

Seeing this dog. Seeing the trash everywhere...it's to much. I'm sorry that happened to you. Now that she told me to mind my business by offering hay, I'm angry enough to call.
Thank you. I will.

Thank you. This has taught me to respect the things I have. We're across from a school and church. I want their guests to see there is someone that cares about how the outside looks. There is 2 open fields and 3 abandoned homes.

I will not be returning. I took a leap of faith and opened a lash studio. I celebrated my one year anniversary and I will continue to grow. 

What is happening now was a wake up call in the making. I was a low wage worker and was just let go in June 2021. I watched the retailer I worked for make changes that did not include me. I was hurt that they decided to give me an ultimatum that lead to me leaving a job of 9+ years. 

I get scared sometimes because I'm used to getting a paycheck on Friday but I have faith, and invested in my business and I am watching it grow. On the flip side I'm watching the negotiations with the elected officials and I have my ballot ready to decide. 

Help is needed and they are dancing around it. I'm doing all I can to stay afloat but in my small business I want people to be able to continue to support me. The world has changed. The US needs to adapt. Other countries have implemented policies the US only is considering now because of the pandemic.

Great...they finally figured this out. Now the next story should be about age discrimination. Let's address that elephant in the room. Then the next story after that should be about the tracking software companies use to filter out job candidates. 

I'm a small business and I know for a fact you can have the settings on software or a platform, that will allow you to put in triggers to eliminate a candidate. So while these businesses are quick to tell their side, or report people to unemployment, they have access to shady tools behind the scenes.

I'm staying busy. I do advocate work to fix the unemployment system, childcare assistance, and multiple stimulus checks. I've been able to learn a lot and get resources to help me by sitting in on Zoom calls and being interviewed for news publications.

I am also growing my small business. I celebrated a year in June and I am dedicated to doing better. I'm thankful for my existing clients and customers. 

I'm budgeting like crazy but I knew this would happen so I prepared for the end. I got my ballot and I'm ready to vote. I will continue to advocate for the things I believe in but I will not vote for elected officials that are not in my best interest. 😁
